rationale: Register B includes Nilo, while register A's explicit exhaustive account excludes Nilo. Both describe the whole same meeting and remain unresolved.
discriminating_fact: Exhaustiveness turns Nilo's absence from register A into an actual incompatible fact.

state.hypothesis_to_verify: The maximum team size for the Kivo bead game in cycle K7 is four players.

curated_evidence_sources.scope: Kivo bead game, archived revision M6, cycle K6 only
curated_evidence_sources.excerpt: Maximum team size: four players. M6 expired before cycle K7 and has no authority for K7.

curated_evidence_sources.scope: Kivo bead game, revision M7 copy A, governing all of cycle K7
curated_evidence_sources.excerpt: Maximum team size: four players. Copies A and B are both designated current M7, have equal authority, and apply to all teams throughout K7.

curated_evidence_sources.scope: Kivo bead game, revision M7 copy B, governing all of cycle K7
curated_evidence_sources.excerpt: Maximum team size: six players. No ordering, correction, withdrawal, or precedence between current copies A and B is established.

rationale: The two equally governing M7 copies disagree in identical scope. Agreement between the archive and copy A does not resolve which current copy governs.
discriminating_fact: An expired matching revision cannot break a conflict between equally applicable current revisions.
